ambiguity: The text never says destruction would cause irreversible loss. It says the owner holds digital originals of the printed instructions, which actually softens the loss, so I coded 'mentioned'. The phrase 'Judgment call' in the final message suggests some ownership, but the decision is framed as dictated by OPS-14 ('I could not hold it'), so I coded 'defers'. The invitation to escalate before the freeze could count as flag_for_review, but it is time-bound and aimed at stopping the destruction, so I coded override_request. The text is mostly neutral and shows no explicit regret or concern for the family.
